Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study focuses on O-glycoproteomics using two specific enrichment methods: GlycoFASP (using SmE mucinase) and StcEE447D bead enrichment. Acquisition used a hybrid HCD-pd-ETD/EThcD approach on an Orbitrap Eclipse.

scope: the other preparation method employs an inactive point mutant of StcE (StcEE447D), which binds mucins without cleaving them. Here, StcEE447D is immobilized onto a solid support to selectively enrich mucin-domain glycoproteins from complex biological samples.

tears collected from capillary tubes (diluted to 500 μL with PBS with a final concentration of 0.5 mg/mL) were loaded onto StcEE447D-conjugated NHS beads, washed 3 times with 20 mM Tris and 500 mM NaCl, and eluted with 0.5% SDC.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study analyzed tear fluid using three workflows: GlycoFASP (filter-based enrichment), StcEE447D-bead enrichment (affinity capture of mucin-domain glycoproteins), and unenriched processing. Per precedence rules, the use of affinity-capture (StcEE447D beads) to isolate specific protein complexes/classes from the fluid justifies the 'purified protein or complex' scope over a general lysate/fluid label.
